title: Outage Report Work Order Form
subtitle: An original outage report workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete outage report work order form for the utility interruption and restoration event that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The outage coordination lead owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Outage report work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: Outage report asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact utility interruption and restoration event and define work that is included and excluded.

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Validate outage event, service type, location, and reporting source
Screen life safety and route emergency indicators immediately
Link duplicate reports and map distinct affected pockets
Identify critical facilities, dependent services, and priority consequences
Coordinate crew, operations control, access, and public-protection actions
Record device or area status without directing unauthorized switching
Track affected count, restoration stage, estimated time, and confidence
Publish approved customer and partner updates at the assigned cadence
Verify restoration by system evidence and representative customer feedback
Transfer remaining pockets, damage, and corrective work to named owners

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: Outage report pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: This record supports situational awareness; it does not authorize switching, valve operation, entry, or approach to damaged utility equipment. Keep callers and the public away from downed lines, gas odors, flooding, fire, and unstable areas. Route emergency indicators immediately and leave isolation and restoration decisions to designated operations control and qualified crews. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: Outage report work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: Outage report exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Downed or sagging conductor, arcing, fire, or damaged electrical asset
Gas odor, hissing, damaged main, regulator, or atmosphere concern
Water-main break, flooding, washout, sinkhole, or energized water exposure
Steam, pressure, chemical, traffic, debris, or unstable structure
Public entry into an uncontrolled utility work or damage zone
Unknown system state, backfeed, switching, valve, or isolation status
Critical-service consequence beyond the current response capability
Any condition requiring emergency command or operations control
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record supports situational awareness; it does not authorize switching, valve operation, entry, or approach to damaged utility equipment. Keep callers and the public away from downed lines, gas odors, flooding, fire, and unstable areas. Route emergency indicators immediately and leave isolation and restoration decisions to designated operations control and qualified crews.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Outage report decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Utility interruption and restoration event identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
